correctness.rationale: Constructing the 4x4 rook graph and the Cayley Shrikhande graph on Z4^2 confirms 16 vertices, valency six, two common neighbors for every pair. For each vertex v the open neighborhood in the complement is V\N_G[v]; its downward closure K_G is Alexander dual to the dominance complex because V\sigma fails to belong to K_G exactly when the complement dominates G. Integral combinatorial Alexander duality on 16 vertices has degree shift 16-i-3=13-i, which transfers cohomology of K_G to homology of D(G). Full enumeration gives K_R 5,789 faces and K_S 5,717 faces including empty, as in the source. An independently rebuilt GF(2) boundary reduction yields Betti K_R in dimensions 2 and 4 of ranks 2 and 1, K_S in dimension 4 of rank 11; this does not by itself prove integral torsion-freeness. The frozen integral verifier constructs exact signed integer boundary maps, checks every elementary simplicial collapse, then 324 and 530 Schur-complement cancellations at integer unit pivots on the two reduced cores. Inspection of its elimination logic shows these are genuine free-chain contractions over Z and terminal differentials vanish; the remaining free integral generators yield K_R H2=Z^2,H4=Z and K_S H4=Z^11, whence the stated D_R H9=Z,H11=Z^2 and D_S H9=Z^11. No homotopy type is inferred from chain cancellations.
residual_risks: Independent modular arithmetic does not alone rule out integral torsion; torsion-free conclusion depends on the inspected integer unit-reduction algorithm and its explicit zero terminal differential.
No homotopy equivalence or equivariant character for the dominance complexes is proved.

value.rationale: The exact integral homology of a natural dominance complex for the two archetypal nonisomorphic strongly regular graphs with identical (16,6,2,2) parameters is a meaningful topological comparison: one complex has homology in two degrees, the other one, and torsion is completely resolved. This is not merely a re-tabulation of known domination polynomials or a claim to be the first invariant distinguishing the graphs.
residual_risks: Only integral homology (not homotopy) is classified; a pre-existing exact table would reduce originality.

limitations: Full integer cancellation is established by source script and certificate design; independent replay here of every unit pivot was not carried out, so confidence relies on transparent inspected code.
